skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a column with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 450% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 2 rounds and a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on the main target for 1 round. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free by 12% and deals 180% ATK [Collapse DMG] when the affected target is attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse]. [Stun]: Prevents the affected unit from acting. At most 4 characters can be stunned simultaneously.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a column with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 600% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 2 rounds and a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on the main target and another enemy in the same column for 1 round. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free by 15% and deals 230% ATK [Collapse DMG] when the affected target is attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse]. [Stun]: Prevents the affected unit from acting. At most 4 characters can be stunned simultaneously.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self a 55% chance of [Evasion]. After any character acts, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG to enemies affected by [Specialized Collapse], up to 2 times per round. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants allies in the same row a 60% chance of [Evasion]. After any character acts, deals 650% ATK as Extra DMG to enemies affected by [Specialized Collapse], up to 3 times per round. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Acceleration]. At the start of every round, increases the SPD of allies in the same row to 92% of Gale Wind’s SPD if their current SPD is lower. Grants immunity to [Fear] and [Energy Removal]. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases SPD by 28%. If the main target’s SPD is lower than Gale Wind’s SPD, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Acceleration]. At the start of every round, increases the SPD of allies in the same row to 96% of Gale Wind’s SPD if their current SPD is lower. Grants immunity to [Fear] and [Energy Removal]. At the beginning of each round, applies [Encourage] to allies. Permanently grants immunity to [Stun]. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases SPD by 32%. If the main target’s SPD is lower than Gale Wind’s SPD, deals 600% ATK as Extra DMG. [Encourage]: Gains 3 Energy at the start of each round for 3 rounds.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Power up at the beginning of each round for several rounds.
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
PvP debuff reduces target's Damage Reduction by 10% and deals 250% Shatter damage each time the target is attacked.
Increases ally's speed to near deployer's speed (remains the same if ally is already faster).
